selection_reason: SEC-02 completed_verified and SEC strict order requires SEC-03 next.
objective: Re-evaluate the existing 14 supernatural effect families against SEC-01 corpus evidence and SEC-02 capability/purpose observations. Determine which coarse buckets—especially Utility—should remain, split, merge, or gain first-class families. Candidate concepts include Adaptation/Resistance, Communication, Binding/Banishment, Resource Transfer, Environment/Weather, Purification/Corruption, Construction/Repair, Probability/Luck, Identity/Soul, Technology Interface, Spatial Containment, Causality and Translation, but these are investigative candidates rather than pre-approved families.

acceptance_profile.audit_not_auto_accept: Every current family and candidate family receives an evidence-backed disposition; no candidate becomes canonical merely because it was proposed.
acceptance_profile.preserve_capability_taxonomy: SEC-02 capability/purpose taxonomy remains a separate discoverability/completeness lens and is not replaced by effect families.
acceptance_profile.source_and_mechanism_boundaries: No spell, power, ritual, Rune construction, species innate, Living Spellbook effect or other supernatural mechanism is silently merged, renamed, converted or mechanically rewritten.
acceptance_profile.later_sec_boundaries: SEC-04 retains family/variant grammar; SEC-05 retains tradition/reality compatibility; SEC-06+ retains expansion authority; SEC-09 retains final completeness proof.
acceptance_profile.validation: Focused invariant verifier plus exact-head repository health and governed Linux/Windows deterministic Validation Core must pass before merge.
